question: In which of the following states are the snake boat races held in the months of August and September?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Snake boat race**__

 __
 
• **The snake boat race gets its name from the shape of the boat used for racing. It is held in the months of August and September.**
 
• **It is a long canoe-style boat that is used by the people in Kerala to participate in the racing competitions in the backwaters. **
 
• **This is a historical war boat of Kerala which is about 100-120 ft long and can hold up to about 100 rowers.**
 
• Snake boat is the pride of the villages in this region and every village has snake boats of its own.
 
• Snake Boat Race has been associated with the state for over 400 years now.
 
• The story of this boat race has been traced to the ancient king, Alleppey, who was known for fighting battles with the kings of nearby regions along the canals.
 
• Every year the boats are oiled mainly with fish oil, coconut shell, and carbon to keep the wood strong and the boat slippery in the water.
